scientific_limitations: Exactness and extremizer rigidity proven only for integer m >= 2 and n >= 1000000(m+1)^6.
Conservative sufficient threshold; no assertion of minimal threshold or all-size exactness.
Only centered graph-ball maximal operator with counting measure on unweighted complete bipartite graphs.
Bibliographic novelty depends on indexed and inspected accessible sources; no independent scientific validation.
title: Eventual exact Hilbert norm and extremizer rigidity for complete-bipartite maximal averages
